svg.title: ABCDE heuristics
svg.desc: A synthetic lesion is converted to grey, thresholded with Otsu, its largest contour is traced and the four computable ABCDE scores are reported.
svg.text: compute_abcde_criteria on a synthetic dark lesion
All numbers below come from the real functions in explainability.py applied to the image on the left.

g.text: mean |col j − col W−1−j| / 255, j < min(cx, W−cx)
np.var over all R, G, B values
THRESH_BINARY marks pixels brighter than T as foreground. Here the foreground is the skin (79% of the image),
so the largest external contour runs along the image frame and D = 240 px ÷ 10. On all ten images in media/ the measured contour also touches the border.
The scores are therefore image-level heuristics, not measurements of the lesion. See docs/09-abcde-heuristics.md.
